Mathematician Eric Weinstein joins Joe Rogan to warn that we may be faking a UFO wave in a segment from the show. Weinstein is known for bold takes on science and power. His line here is one of doubt aimed at the disclosure tale itself.

Weinstein argues the state could stage or steer the UFO tale to hide real arms work or to bend the crowd. He urges fans to ask who gains from each new clip and claim. Rogan, a fan of the lore, hears him out. Listeners get a skeptic's splash from a smart friend of the show. The library holds the segment as an archive record.
